issue_context.title: [mono] bug about wasm single thread using lock
issue_context.body:
we found the object interop between js and c# excecute slowly
you can find below flame graph:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9e25cb2a-e807-49a5-9f59-e10a6b394f3e)

the `AssertNotDisposed` take most time of argument transfer.

we use single thread, Is it not necessary using lock at below functions : https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/da4f0a33ecec67908327138bfa0f153c3821fa78/src/libraries/System.Runtime.InteropServices.JavaScript/src/System/Runtime/InteropServices/JavaScript/JSObject.References.cs#L48-L54

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/da4f0a33ecec67908327138bfa0f153c3821fa78/src/libraries/System.Runtime.InteropServices.JavaScript/src/System/Runtime/InteropServices/JavaScript/Marshaling/JSMarshalerArgument.Task.cs#L41-L50


should it wrapper with `FEATURE_WASM_MANAGED_THREADS` as other function do.

```c#
internal void AssertNotDisposed()
        {
#if FEATURE_WASM_MANAGED_THREADS
            lock (ProxyContext)
#endif
            {
                ObjectDisposedException.ThrowIf(IsDisposed, this);
            }
        }
```

review_comments: curious why this triggers, it seems to be used? unless the analyzer notices that Environment.IsSingleProcessor is always true?

It notices and that's a good thing :)
It tells me to propagate `const` further, bu I don't want to pollute the whole codebase
I want this to be propagated as a constant so that pieces of code could be elided.
~~const will do the same thing?~~ sorry, misread this. const is the better way I agree.
would a linker substitution have accomplished the same thing?

This `#if` check seems redundant since we're inside the `#else` block for the previous `#if !FEATURE_WASM_MANAGED_THREADS`  (e.g. the thing we're testing is already known).

Was something else intended? If not, we can delete line 30 and 32, because they are _known_ to be active here. 

I suspect this was caused by the sweep to wrap/bypass all the `lock` calls, and just happens to be provably not needed here.

Full conditional context [shown here](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/113046/files#diff-6651067349f868184cc9fa01dfa74d6dce35a3a5f4f3dc7589adc2c03328a23eR22-R53)
